articles.title: Handel: China fordert von den USA Aufhebung von Zöllen

articles.image_title: Handel: YIWU, CHINA - APRIL 28: A worker makes festive goods for export next to items made for the U.S. market at a factory on April 28, 2025 in Yiwu, Zhejiang Province, China. The Yiwu area is home to thousands of China's small commodities companies, many of which in recent years due to trade tensions with the United States have looked to the Middle East, Africa and South America for new business. After President Trump put tariffs as high as 145 percent on Chinese goods, many producers saw orders from American clients cancelled or at least temporarily put on hold. (Photo by Kevin Frayer/Getty Images)
